basic_info.description: Pristine home in the Portola District on one of the best blocks! Located on a cul-de-sac with no thru traffic. Walk to 3 Private Schools and McLaren and Louis Sutter parks. 1 block to Muni or short drive to Glen Park BART or Caltrain. 7 minutes to downtown or 15 to SFO. Upstairs consists of 3BR and 2ba, remodeled eat in kitchen and ALL 3 baths are remodeled, Living and dining room combo with frplc. 4 skylights offer natural light abundantly. Downstairs has 4th BR and full bath (with permit per seller). Deck off lower bedroom with low maintenance yard.2 car side by side garage with auto garage, forced air heat, circuit breakers, and newer water heater.
